Actual current compiler evidence at `9ad00e8d04eb64fb6cba987ae5c9eabd496deca0`: [complete literal acceptance and cost report](https://github.com/wavect/semaprax/tree/9ad00e8d04eb64fb6cba987ae5c9eabd496deca0/docs/evidence/closure877878-supplement-20261017). All 23 additional exact acceptance owners passed from the existing f1 library artifact; whole selected source equality and docs-only checkout drift were checked. No new Cargo job or live-agent benchmark ran.

The #878 owned-suffix handoff and borrowed representative-key storage reduce actual cumulative heap allocation in these fixtures but increase their printed `held` accounting metric:

- Borrowed path merge: held12,520→54,604; allocated9,152→8,224; peak5,696→4,744.
- Borrowed call merge: held18,848→56,212; allocated11,984→9,832; peak7,528→6,088.
- Owned suffix: held40,683→94,691; allocated28,256→22,248; peak13,424→13,184.

These are matched real receiver fixtures, not an application saving or removable-cost estimate. Original work, all six diagnostic fields, floor/foreign/sticky behavior and full Drop checks passed. #808 application memory refusals remain open.

Find the actual new selector/iterator/lookup/insertion/publication/argument/formal/result roles responsible for the higher charge and reduce it by physically retaining or eliminating those receivers. A prepaid persistent owner is appropriate only where the actual state survives across operations; do not introduce a paid-once flag around recreated values. Alternatively use a genuinely funded selection of the complete old route when the proposed representation is not beneficial, with selection overhead included.

Retain complete independent old/current receivers and all original controls. Do not raise caps, subtract guessed debits, refund charges, pad the baseline or silently discard fields. Preserve exact work/failure/destruction order and acquire every actual receiver before formation. Report full old/current paid/allocated/peak outcomes, including any small-input regression; assert output equivalence and full Drop across exact/short/zero/floor/sticky/foreign frontiers. Actual end-to-end application and agent-token effects require their own measured evidence.

Implement in a large batch, then run only the affected focused owners and scoped production Clippy if production code changes. No full suites or full quality gates.
title: (OPT) Reduce receiving-control overhead in borrowed merge and owned suffix storage
